apps.privacyPolicyHtml:
SOFTWARE TESTING & AUTOMATION UTILITY

Privacy Policy for Auto Clicker

Package ID: com.kbh.precisionautoclicker • Effective Date: January 1, 2026

Summary: Auto Clicker operates 100% locally on your device. We do not collect, track, sell, or transmit personal data, screen content, keystrokes, or usage telemetry to external servers.

1. Overview & Scope

This Privacy Policy explains how Auto Clicker (com.kbh.precisionautoclicker), a personal-purpose software testing, UI verification, and accessibility automation utility, handles device permissions and local configuration storage.

2. Information We Do Not Collect

Auto Clicker is engineered with a strict zero-collection architecture. The application does not collect, access, store externally, or share:

  • Personally identifiable information (name, email address, phone number, or account credentials).
  • Device identifiers, advertising IDs, IP addresses, or precise geolocation data.
  • Keystrokes, passwords, notifications, financial details, or personal messages.
  • Screenshots, screen recordings, or analytics/crash telemetry sent to third-party servers.

3. Local On-Device Storage

All user-created automation profiles, target screen coordinates, timing intervals, hold durations, and interface preferences (such as dark/light theme and marker appearance) are saved exclusively on your local device using Android Room SQLite, SharedPreferences, or browser localStorage. You maintain full control and may delete saved presets inside the app or remove all stored data by clearing app storage or uninstalling the application.

4. Android AccessibilityService API Disclosure

To execute automated touch testing and repetitive click workflows on Android, Auto Clicker requests permission to use the Android AccessibilityService API. This permission is strictly limited to:

  • Dispatching touch gestures (taps and timed holds via dispatchGesture()) at the exact screen coordinates configured by the user.
  • Inspecting active window transition status strictly for real-click test diagnostics.

Auto Clicker never uses the AccessibilityService to collect personal data, monitor text input, bypass security prompts, or transmit screen contents off your device.

5. Display Over Other Apps (Overlay Permission)

The SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission is used solely to render floating control widgets (Start, Pause, Stop, Add Target) and draggable target markers over other applications during testing or automation sessions. You can toggle off the overlay at any time inside the app or revoke the permission in Android System Settings.

6. Third-Party Services & Advertising

Auto Clicker does not embed third-party advertising networks, behavioral tracking SDKs, or external data brokers. No user data is shared with third parties.

7. Children's Privacy

This software testing utility is not directed toward children under the age of 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children.

8. Policy Updates & Contact Information

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to remain transparent and compliant with platform requirements. If you have questions or privacy inquiries regarding Auto Clicker, please contact:

Developer Contact: bhargavbor597@gmail.com

© 2026 Auto Clicker (com.kbh.precisionautoclicker) • Software Testing & Accessibility Utility

# Privacy Policy
**KHB Private Limited (KAMBARIYA-HB ENTERPRISE PRIVATE LIMITED)**
*Last updated: September 1, 2026*

This Privacy Policy explains how KHB Private Limited ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and discloses information about you when you use our mobile applications, games, and website services.

### 1. Information We Collect
We believe in minimal data collection. Most of our utility apps and casual games function entirely on-device without requiring an account.
- **Device & Technical Information:** Hardware model, operating system version, anonymous device identifiers, and general diagnostic crash logs.
- **Support & Inquiries:** When you contact us directly via email or our support forms, we receive your name, email address, and message contents.

### 2. Information We Do Not Collect
- We do NOT collect personal financial account data, government ID numbers, or sensitive personal documents.
- We do NOT sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.

### 3. Third-Party Services & Advertising
Some of our free applications display advertisements provided by Google AdMob. These services may collect pseudonymous identifiers (e.g., Google Advertising ID) subject to their respective privacy policies:
- **Google Play Services:** https://policies.google.com/privacy
- **Google AdMob:** https://support.google.com/admob/answer/6128543

### 4. Children's Privacy
Our applications comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and Google Play Families Policy. Apps targeted toward general audiences or families do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without verifiable parental consent.

### 5. Data Security
We implement industry-standard security protocols to protect data against unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.

### 6. User Rights & Contact
You have the right to inquire about any data we retain or request its deletion. For any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, contact us at:
**Email:** support@khbenterprise.com  
**Legal Entity:** KAMBARIYA-HB ENTERPRISE PRIVATE LIMITED

faqs.q: How do I backup or restore data in your utility apps?
faqs.a: Our utility applications store your automation profiles, presets, and preferences securely on your local device storage. You can manage or clear saved presets directly inside the app Settings at any time.

faqs.q: Are your apps and casual games free to use?
faqs.a: Yes! Our utility apps and games are free to download on Google Play. Some apps display non-intrusive advertisements served through Google AdMob to support continuous development.

faqs.q: Do your apps require an active internet connection?
faqs.a: Our core productivity tools, calculators, and casual games operate 100% offline. Network permissions are only utilized when refreshing external currency rates, checking for updates, or loading Google Play advertisements.

faqs.q: How can I report a bug or crash?
faqs.a: Use the support form on this page! Please mention your device model, Android OS version, and the steps to reproduce the issue. Our engineering team responds to all verified bug reports.
